lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Clusters of high-luminance white pixels are arranged in distinct vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. These local maxima exhibit a grid-like spatial distribution with relatively uniform spacing along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured lattice where the blobs serve as anchor nodes at the intersections of horizontal and vertical gradients.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient exhibiting high-intensity values on the superior edge and low-intensity values (shadowing) on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance pixel clusters located within the posterior half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal fish) are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the right pectoral fin.
